full_name: Joanna Aizenberg | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Physical Sciences Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor at Radcliffe Harvard University
bio: Joanna Aizenberg is the Amy Smith Berylson Professor of Materials Science and a professor of chemistry and chemical biology at the Harvard School of Engineering and Applied Sciences and the Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor at Radcliffe.
